papers.title: WorkDrive: Roadwork Chain of Causation for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Tianyi Jiang, Wen Zhang, Sihan Yang, Ming Lu, Wentao Zhang
papers.summary: Autonomous driving VLM for roadwork zone reasoning — constructs explicit chain-of-causation to connect work-zone observations to correct planning decisions.

papers.title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
papers.authors: Susie Lu, Haonan Chen, Weirui Ye, Yilun Du
papers.summary: Action-conditioned world model using drifting generative models — learns to generate future frames in one step rather than iterative denoising for fast robot planning.

papers.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
papers.authors: Yunfan Jiang, Yevgen Chebotar, Ruijie Zheng, Fengyuan Hu, Yunhao Ge, Jimmy Wu, Tianyuan Dai, Scott Reed, Li Fei-Fei, Yuke Zhu, Linxi Fan
papers.summary: Robot foundation model scaling visuomotor context to 8K timesteps via test-time training. Enables one-shot in-context imitation from human video.

papers.title: CosFly-VLA: A Spatially Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Tracking
papers.authors: Ruilong Ren, Songsheng Cheng, Yunpeng Zhou, Hanxuan Chen, Xiangyue Wang, Tianle Zeng, Shuai Yuan, Binbo Li, Hanzhong Guo, Ji Pei, Da Zhang, Kangli Wang
papers.summary: Spatially-aware VLA policy for UAV tracking under occlusion — maintains target state through buildings and vegetation.

papers.title: DRIFT: Drift and Aggregation for Motion Planning
papers.authors: Yining Xing, Zhiyuan Liu, Zehong Ke, Wenhao Yu, Jianqiang Wang
papers.summary: End-to-end trajectory planner combining one-step drifting in trajectory latent space with scene-aware proposal aggregation for autonomous driving.

papers.title: Variational Inference for Bird's Eye View Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jingyue Shi, Huaicheng Li, Junhui Zhao, Yanxiang Jiang
papers.summary: Recasts BEV segmentation as variational inference problem for better multi-camera fusion in autonomous driving.

papers.title: MIND-CAVs: Multi-Intelligence Negotiation and Decision System for CAVs based on Intent-Driven Autonomy
papers.authors: Mainak Mondal, Yihang Feng, Yangchao Luo, Han Song
papers.summary: Intent-driven negotiation framework for connected autonomous vehicles sharing high-level maneuver intentions via edge computing.

papers.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
papers.authors: Qi Li, Xingyi Yang, Xinchao Wang
papers.summary: Adversarial vulnerability analysis for world-action models — shows the coupling of action prediction and world prediction is fragile.

papers.title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Weishuai Zeng, Kangning Yin, Xiaojie Niu et al.
papers.summary: Scaling behavior foundation models for humanoid whole-body coordination and control.

papers.title: A Model Predictive Control Framework for Assisted Vehicle Drifting
papers.authors: Marco Cortese, Antonio Gallina, Matteo Grandin et al.
papers.summary: NMPC framework for assisted drifting with driver in the loop — human-autonomy shared control for vehicle drifting.
